speaker: Livia Capulet
text: Hi, honey. Is this a bad time?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: No, perfect timing. I'm just heading out for lunch. Hi, Mom.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: I won't keep you. I wanted to check on Sunday. Six thirty still works?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Six thirty's great. I just made a list, actually. Who's coming, the cake, the gift.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: Of course you made a list.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Of course I did. Is it still lemon?

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: It's always lemon. Your father would riot. But he can't know about the cake. He thinks it's just dinner.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Mom, he knows. He knows every year.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: He pretends he doesn't, and that's the whole point. Is Rosaline coming?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: I'm seeing her in ten minutes. I'll ask her.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: Tell her to bring nothing. She'll bring something anyway.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: She'll bring a bowl. She's taking a pottery class.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: Oh, that's lovely. And Juliet, did you book Paris yet?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: I know, I know. Tonight. I promise.

speaker: Livia Capulet
text: Okay. Go eat something. Love you.
